events.title: Steam Next Fest Reveal: Our Updated Demo Is Joining the Festival!
events.summary: Hey everyone!We can finally share the news: we’re joining Steam Next Fest!Our updated demo builds on the original with an extra level and a ton of polish. And with Twitch chat integration, there’s another reason to bring your community along when you stream.When the festival begins, jump in! If you enjoy the demo, please leave a Steam review to help other players discover the game as we get closer to release.Wishlist the game to stay in the loop, and stay tuned for more exciting news coming soon

events.title: Angel Guardian Brings Twitch-Integrated Gameplay to Steam Cyberpunk Fest
events.summary: The wait is over! events.title: Thank YOU for an incredible playtest.
events.summary: Our latest playtest for Angel Guardian has come to an end.Over the past weeks, players from all over the world jumped into Alterra, fought alongside Kita and Eiji, and experienced the game in their own way. Watching that unfold has been one of the most meaningful parts of development so far.We’re already using your feedback to improve combat feel, balance, and overall flow.
